understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked + at the same time; the level is won only when all goals are occupied.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces are moved by clicking reachable target positions on the grid. Walls and obstacles block movement, and invalid or inaccessible clicks leave the selected piece unchanged. A piece can move between accessible positions, but the run ended before all pieces reached their goals.
